recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. If BRR wants crossReference.product to become optional, handle that as a new explicit cardinality decision rather than inferring it from the ambiguous 0..1 text in FHIR-26570.
issue_request: FHIR-26570 was a Published/Persuasive BRR R5 change request to simplify MedicinalProductDefinition.crossReference.product from an Identifier|Reference choice to CodeableReference(MedicinalProductDefinition), allowing coded, referenced, identified, or text descriptions of related products through CodeableReference.
initial_application: Commit d2e6d81f27044374ce30401b189d3de9cd0d5a4d explicitly applied FHIR-26570 by changing the historical spreadsheet type from Identifier|Reference(MedicinalProductDefinition) to CodeableReference(MedicinalProductDefinition). Commit 85fd3327b880055735fc2c5a09c7b6ea6ef71086 later removed the obsolete [x] suffix, and the later XML source migration retained the resulting CodeableReference element.
additional_context: BRR 2020-05-05 minutes record the accepted FHIR-26570 motion as changing MedicinalProduct references to CodeableReferences with a 9-0-0 vote. The Jira free-text proposal mentions 0..1 cardinality, but the meeting summary and implementing commits do not independently approve or apply a cardinality relaxation; retaining product as required preserves the meaning of a cross-reference entry.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. The active current resource source defines MedicinalProductDefinition.crossReference.product as a 1..1 CodeableReference targeting MedicinalProductDefinition, examples use crossReference.product.reference, and searches found no stale productIdentifier/productReference or Identifier|Reference representation in source/medicinalproductdefinition.

related_jiras.note: Applied in the same d2e6d81 commit but concerns the separate productClassification-to-classification rename, so it was not decided here.
